get.summary: Read the quotas of an api key
get.description: Answers the calls the api key is allowed to make, made and has left in the current throttling window, the current day and the current month, as counted by its throttling strategy. The calls of every route and api the key is authorized on are counted together.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The client id of the api key

200.description: The quotas of the api key

400.description: The credentials are missing: the call carries no api key, and the route that serves the admin api refuses it before the controller runs

401.description: The credentials are wrong, or they do not give access to the admin api

403.description: The admin behind the credentials cannot read (or, for a reset, write) this api key: it is not in its tenant or teams

404.description: No api key has this client id

429.description: The quotas of the credentials, or the number of calls allowed per ip address, are exceeded

delete.summary: Reset the quotas of an api key
delete.description: Sets the calls the api key made in the current throttling window, day and month back to zero, through its throttling strategy, and answers its quotas once reset. The key can call again right away if it had exhausted them.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The client id of the api key

200.description: The quotas of the api key, once reset

400.description: The credentials are missing: the call carries no api key, and the route that serves the admin api refuses it before the controller runs

401.description: The credentials are wrong, or they do not give access to the admin api

403.description: The admin behind the credentials cannot read (or, for a reset, write) this api key: it is not in its tenant or teams

404.description: No api key has this client id

429.description: The quotas of the credentials, or the number of calls allowed per ip address, are exceeded
